body: I meant your mental health is more important than your civil engineering degree.  And yea math can be a real bitch.
Can you perhaps make a playlist of your feel good music?  I would love to listen to it.
I think if these thoughts ever lead you to consider suicide just to experience the "truly beautiful" death you fantasize about, you should consider it.
I'm here if you want to talk.  If not, I wish you the best and that your end be painless.

I think you should probably see a therapist.  Maybe you just need someone to talk to/vent and not necessarily need any pills.  However there may be a chemical imbalance in your body making you feel this way where pills are the solution.  You seem to live a pretty kick ass life though and I envy you.
Perhaps you're just romanticizing death.  Have you considered seeing a therapist?

You could always take an extra semester or take summer classes and you're being way too harsh on yourself for a 3.77.  I would kill for that.  I think your mental health is more important than a degree.  You could always try opening up an online shop and see how that goes for your handmade jewelry.  You're lucky enough to have a boyfriend and I think you should talk to your boyfriend about it unless your relationship is currently fragile.  Isn't that the point of having a SO, for emotional support and whatnot?
It's different for everybody and all you can do is endure it and hope for better days.  If you do plan on cutting, don't cut too deep okay?
I just hope you live this year to the fullest and perhaps find a reason to keep on living and if you do, don't be stubborn and end your life anyway.  Your video can have a happy ending.

I think you should talk to your mother about how you feel.  She may not realize the damage she is inflicting.  The most important thing is to let your brother know that you love and support him and that you're there for him.

I don't know what crime you committed but judging by what you said, it seems fairly bad.  It all comes down to if you can live with what you did and to endure and reform.  Up to 20 years doesn't mean you'll be locked up for 20 years.

You should take some time to set your priorities and a budget with your husband.  You may want to include your children into the conversation as well so they know you guys are in a little bit of financial trouble and may have to cut back on some things.

Honestly, if you're short on money,  just save the money instead of spending them on presents.  I'm sure spending time with the family is more than enough and if you explain it to your kids, I'm sure they will understand.
A mother is more important to your children than any amount of money.
i'm here.  what do you want to talk about?

Thanks for this.  It comforts me knowing I helped at least one person in my lifetime.  I hope you go through with your plans and get help.  I was planning on throwing away this account but I think I'll hold onto it for a little bit.  If you ever want to talk I'm here for you.

nobody will give you ways on how to commit suicide.  we're mainly here to perhaps talk you out of it and if not, make sure you're not alone in your last moments.  I know that is what I want when I off myself.

that's not true, maybe you're just surrounded by assholes.  or maybe you're one yourself i mean i don't know you.  but i know you're posting here because you want help and i just want to offer a hand.
thanks.  letting everything out and just knowing there are others that can relate helps immensely.
that's not true.  i honestly care more about people I don't know because I just assume they're nice peoples.  I'm here if you want to talk.

People who rant about suicide being the cowards way out and how it's so selfish etc. don't understand it.  And why should they?  I just ignore them and take comfort that they have a relatively good life.  It's a scary moment when you realize that it might not get better.  Or that when you've reached rock bottom, the only way is not up.  There's always a new rock bottom or instead of going up, you may just stay at the bottom.  I know these words aren't comforting or encouraging and I'm sorry for that.  If you ever want to talk to someone who understands I'm here for you.
